versions.notes: At least 4 weeks; at least 2 weeks (consecutive if the worker asks) taken in the accrual year, the rest within 18 months after its end (art. 10 c. 1). Article text verified on normattiva.it; decree in force 29-04-2003 per GU page.

rules.description: INPS sickness indemnity for employees: 50% of average daily pay from day 4 to day 20, 66.66% from day 21 to day 180; first three days paid by the employer only if the contract provides

source.title: INPS — Indennità di malattia/degenza ospedaliera e visite mediche di controllo

versions.notes: INPS page (updated 21 September 2026): indemnity from the fourth day; first three days at the employer's charge if the contract provides; 50% of average daily pay days 4-20, 66.66% days 21-180; at most 180 days in the calendar year (industry workers and tertiary-sector workers on open-ended contracts); fixed-term: days worked in the previous 12 months, minimum 30, maximum 180; public establishments and pastry workshops 80% for the whole period; normally advanced by the employer. Other categories (entertainment, maritime) and CCNL top-ups not modelled. INPS (Istituto Nazionale della Previdenza Sociale) added to the allow-list (ADR-0052). effectiveFrom = verification date (historical changes not researched).

rules.description: Civil Code art. 2118: notice on termination of an open-ended contract in the terms and manner set by collective agreements; no statutory minimum; indemnity in lieu

source.title: EURES — Living and working conditions: Italy (European Commission)

versions.notes: EURES Italy (page dated 26/05/2026): the terminating party "must give notice in accordance with the terms and procedures laid down in the collective agreements" (Civil Code art. 2118); notice "may range from a minimum of 15 days to a maximum of three or six months" by service and category; failing notice, compensation for the notice period; no notice period for fixed-term contracts. The primary text on normattiva.it could not be fetched (connection reset), so per ADR-0023 EURES is used and effectiveFrom is the verification date (HUMAN_TODO 3.5). The applicable CCNL determines the actual period: model per collective agreement.
